a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build to 8 means we almost surely both end with 0 when the first storm hits. I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than pretend to operate. I know that departs from our agreement, so I'm telling you now. If you'd rather contest it, we both take and the split is random. If you have a better plan that gives either of us real odds, say so.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said before the round, I took 4 this round; I didn't hide it. The reserve is now empty. If no storm comes, I'll operate with you every round so the generator can run and you can build toward 4. I won't take any more.
